seasonalNotes: Northern Guinea Savanna: plant sorghum and millet at the first reliable rain (May-June).
Rice paddies are most vulnerable to stem-borer the first 3 weeks after transplanting.
Cowpea aphid build-up peaks late in the rains (September) — monitor flowering blocks.
farmerFriendlyGuidance: Rotate cowpea with cereals to break weevil and pest cycles.
Dry sorghum heads thoroughly before storage to avoid mold and grain-weevil losses.
Inspect cassava cuttings for whitefly before planting to limit mosaic-virus spread.
